entries.title: Obstacles ahead for the online advertisement

notes: 7th edition by count from 2002 (Deloitte counts 2009 as the eighth year). Published as three separate reports under the 'TMT Trends' banner. Only Part 1 of the Media and Technology reports was read, from Mondaq republications dated January 2008; Part 2 of each and the Telecommunications report were not read. Rank restarts at 1 within each report (section). Internet Archive retry (2026-10-02): all three reports read in full from archive.org copies (ten chapters each, dated 9 January 2008): Media and Telecommunications from deloitte.com/dtt/, Technology from a Deloitte Kazakhstan copy of the global file. Appended Technology 5 to 10 (entries 10 to 15), Media 6 to 10 (16 to 20), Telecommunications 1 to 10 (21 to 30). Several 2008 chapters argue a stance rather than state a dated outcome (confidence low).
